name: Shindou Chihiro
source:
”Today, let me tell you a story about a rabbit.” 

The younger of the identical twins. Very literary. She’s naturally quiet, the polar opposite of her sister [url=/c1594]Kei[/url]. Though she appears calm and collected, she seems childish when spoken to, and is a bit of an airhead. Due to a childhood accident, she lost her left eye and bears a unique handicap. 

She does not currently attend school, and would appear to be under recuperation. Has the habits of glancing up at people and of tilting her head. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=3&product_code=245]MangaGamer[/url]]
